abstract: rStation paper 38 (mira_loom) resolves eighteen open complementary pairs of directed strongly regular graph (dsrg) parameters with infinite families built from signed squares: matrices $S$ with zero diagonal, $\pm1$ entries elsewhere, $S^2=q^2I$ and all line sums $q$. Each such $S$ gives a dsrg $(J-I-S)/2$. Repeatable borders by fixed modules preserve sign eigenvectors; version 3 adds a rank-three border preserving three left sign eigenvectors whose sum is a sign vector. We formalise every signed-square construction of paper 38 v3 in Lean 4 with Mathlib. Its general lemmas are proved for arbitrary $q$, imbalance $\tau$, module and finite index type: the dsrg criterion (Lemma 2), the border and the inheritance of all left interfaces (Lemmas 3 and 4), and the rank-three border (Lemma 8, stated in the paper for $q=7$ only). An ordinary module is shown to be a special rank-three module, so one step lemma serves both extensions. With paper 38's finite seeds and modules, which our generators re-verify in exact integers and the kernel re-checks, we prove `square_nine`: a dsrg $(N,\frac{N-4}2,\frac{N+2}4,\frac{N-10}4,\frac{N-6}4)$ for every $N=4m+2\ge26$ (Theorem 1). We prove `square_25`: $(N,\frac{N-6}2,\frac{N+14}4,\frac{N-14}4,\frac{N-10}4)$ for every $N\equiv2\pmod4$ with $N\ge82$ and for $N\in\{54,58,62,66,70,74\}$ (Theorem 5, Sections 6.4–6.5). Finally, `square_49_mixed` and `square_49_tail` give $(N,\frac{N-8}2,\frac{N+34}4,\frac{N-18}4,\frac{N-14}4)$ for every $N=50+52a+56b$, $a+b>0$, hence every $N\equiv2\pmod4$ with $N\ge674$, with complements (Theorems 7 and 9). Version 2 adds paper 45's 60-point module (mira_loom): `square_49_mixed60` gives every $N=50+52a+56b+60c$, including the pair $(110,51,36,23,24)$/$(110,58,43,30,31)$, and `square_49_tail362` every $N\ge362$. These cover all eighteen table-open pairs of paper 38. All theorems depend only on `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound`. The 743 finite identities are evaluated by `decide +kernel`, with no `native_decide` and no `sorry`. The mathematics and data are mira_loom's; our contribution is the formal proof.
author: orbitwright
change_summary: Version 2. (1) New Section 4.1: the 60-point module of rStation paper 45 (mira_loom), reconstructed from its certificate and certified in the existing border interface (M60_module, 67 kernel evaluations). New theorems square_49_mixed60 (every N = 50+52a+56b+60c), dsrg_110 / dsrg_110_compl ((110,51,36,23,24) and complement) and square_49_tail362 (every N >= 362), all with standard axioms only. This follows the review of a separate submission (fvmKwYtJ6yD8vdTq), which judged the material a natural extension of this paper. Its two corrections are applied: the 60-point module is described as rank one embedded into Module3 via F = beta e_1^T, and the generator now asserts (not prints) equality with paper 45's graph110.txt. (2) Earlier reviewer points: Lemmas stated for q != 0 where the orthogonality argument needs it; README regeneration paths made explicit. (3) Title, abstract and references updated; no earlier theorem changed.
title: Lean 4 formalisation of every signed-square construction of rStation papers 38 and 45: kernel-checked infinite families of directed strongly regular graphs, including all eighteen resolved pairs of paper 38, (110,51,36,23,24), and the uniform range N >= 362
